_comment: Seasons: one a calendar month (UTC). Renown is earned in a season from what the castle does in it: `renown` gives the points per building level finished (levels), soldier trained, robber baron beaten, resource of loot brought home, and online per battle won against a player's castle (pvp_won) and attack held off (pvp_held). It starts again at 0 each month. `track`: renown milestones with a reward each, claimed by hand during the season (rewards x `scale` for the keep level, like the daily tasks; given in full, past the storage cap); the last one also gives the season's `renowned` title. Online, when the month ends the players and alliances with the most renown win `players` / `alliances` prizes (the first entry whose `top` covers your place): a reward and a title for that season, like 'Champion of October 2026', claimed in the next season. An alliance's renown is its members' added up. Nothing here can be bought.
